description: This file implements the CCSP Message Bus Interface for the CCSP Secure Software Download component, including functions for connecting to the message bus, registering callbacks, and managing resources.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_GetHealth
methods.description: Returns the health status from the component's common data model.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Connects to the message bus, sets up callbacks, and registers events for the CCSP component.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_Initialize
methods.description: Performs initialization tasks for the message bus interface.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_Finalize
methods.description: Performs cleanup tasks for the message bus interface.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Checks the status of the message bus connection.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the message bus interface.
